fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake Rex drives a headless run: each agent session calls rex window new -s rhiza-<repo> with a title naming the run and the step, no rex split is anchored on a driver block, and closing a finished session closes only its own tab
fields.statement: Each agent session of a run (agent steps, checks, fixers and question sessions) opens its own Rex tab in the repo's session, titled for the run and step, instead of splitting a run window anchored on the driver's pane; every run is headless, so it replaces and retires the run-window tiling leaves run-sessions-one-window, agent-steps-tile-run-window, question-sessions-tile-run-window, checks-and-fixes-anchored, anchor-gone-splits-run-window and build-panes
